name: Arrowroot Milk Porridge
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: large cupful of fresh milk
ingredients.originalText: One large cupful of fresh milk

instructions.text: Put the sugar into the milk and the salt into the boiling water
Pour the boiling water into a farina kettle
Mix the arrowroot with cold water to a paste
Add the wet arrowroot to the boiling water and boil, stirring constantly until it is clear
Put in the milk and cook ten minutes, stirring often
Give while warm, adding hot milk should it be thicker than gruel

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put the sugar into the milk and the salt into the boiling water
2. Pour the boiling water into a farina kettle
3. Mix the arrowroot with cold water to a paste
4. Add the wet arrowroot to the boiling water and boil, stirring constantly until it is clear
5. Put in the milk and cook ten minutes, stirring often
6. Give while warm, adding hot milk should it be thicker than gruel
